claim.claim-text: 2. The drive axle system of claim 1 wherein the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) are operable at a same efficiency at different rotational speeds.

3. The drive axle system of claim 1 further comprising a first clutch (150) that selectively couples the first gear set (42) to the drive pinion (36) and a second clutch (152) that selectively couples the second gear set (44) to the drive pinion (36).
4. The drive axle system of claim 1 wherein the first electric motor (38) is rotatable about a first motor axis (110);

5. The drive axle system of claim 4 wherein the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) transmit torque to the differential assembly (32) when the first clutch (150) couples the second gear (132) to the drive pinion (36) and the second clutch (152) couples the fourth gear (142) to the drive pinion (36).

6. The drive axle system of claim 1 wherein the first electric motor (38) transmits torque to the differential assembly (32) when a first clutch (150) couples to the second gear (132) to the drive pinion (36) and the second electric motor (40) does not transmit torque to the differential assembly (32) when a second clutch (152) decouples the second gear set (44) from the drive pinion (36).

7. The drive axle system of claim 4 wherein the second electric motor (40) transmits torque to the differential assembly (32) when the second clutch (152) couples the fourth gear (142) to the drive pinion (36) and the first electric motor (38) does not transmit torque to the differential assembly (32) when the first clutch (150) decouples the first gear set (42) from the drive pinion (36).
9. The drive axle system of claim 8 wherein the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) are rotatable about a motor axis (210).
10. The drive axle system of claim 9 wherein the clutch (300) is disposed along the motor axis (210) between the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40).

11. The drive axle system of any one of claims 8-10 further comprising a second clutch (302), the third clutch (302) being positioned between the first electric motor (38) and the first differential assembly (32) and configured to couple the first electric motor (38) to the first differential assembly (32).

12. The drive axle system of any one of claims 8-11 further comprising a third clutch (304), the third clutch (304) being positioned between the second electric motor (40) and the second differential assembly (32') and configured to couple the second electric motor (40) to the second differential assembly (32').

13. The drive axle system of claim 12 wherein first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) are operatively connected to the first differential assembly (32) but not to the second differential assembly (32') when the clutch (300) couples the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40), the second clutch (302) couples the first electric motor (38) and the first differential assembly (32), and the third clutch (304) decouples the second electric motor (40) from the second differential assembly (32').

14. The drive axle system of claim 12 or claim 13 wherein the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) are operatively connected to the second differential assembly (32') but not to the first differential assembly (32) when the clutch (300) couples the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40), the third clutch (304) couples the second electric motor (40) and the second differential assembly (32'), and the second clutch (302) decouples the first electric motor (38) from the first differential assembly (32).

15. The drive axle system of any one of claims 12 to 14 wherein the first electric motor (38) and the second electric motor (40) are operatively connected to the first differential assembly (32) and the second differential assembly (32') when the clutch (300), the second clutch (302), and the third clutch (304) are engaged.
